text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival.
As for Meisho Doto, she was supposed to participate in the scavenger hunt relay and the hide-and-seek tournament, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hbyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Meisho Doto!
She's dropped her cup in the scavenger hunt race!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I-It's fine, really! It was cheap anyway,
so don't worry about it. Here, use this cup instead!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm s-so sorry, I'm sorry,
I'm so sorry, I'm so sorrrrryyyy...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: And now, pulling herself together, she's returned to the turf! The baton is finally passed—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Noooo waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: I didn't cross it!
After that, it was pure disaster with tripping and breaking the baton, resulting in dead last by a massive margin...!
Afterward, after searching all over for Meisho Doto, who had run off in tears... I found her trembling in the corner of a field.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Why am I... such a klutz...?
After everyone was cheering for me so much, too...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-If only I'd held onto the cup and baton
properly... we could have won for sure~...!

"She seems quite remorseful, but...
we still have the hide-and-seek tournament left."

Just as I was about to encourage her
to give it one last push—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's why... I have to do my best
so I don't mess up next time...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, when it comes to hide-and-seek,
I've actually been praised a little before...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "I always looked for quiet corners so I wouldn't bother anyone, so I know a little bit about good hiding spots...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...All right. I'll do my best. I feel like I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-Here goes...!

Seeing her get back on her feet all on her own made it clear how much she had grown.
—Then, a few hours later.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, now, the moment you've all been waiting for! It's your host for the hide-and-seek tournament, Matikanefukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
For whoever finds the Umamusume, I have plenty of miraculous,
spiritually blessed gifts waiting for you~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, fair and square!
And... START!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Hyawawa~!!
It's already starting~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, if we're here,
they won't find us right away... right?!
However—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, a few hours have passed since the hide-and-seek tournament began! The Fan Thanksgiving is nearing its finale, but—

text_block_list.name: Dotou's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Doto-saaaan!
Where are yooou!?

text_block_list.name: Dotou's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We've searched everywhere that's open to the public, right?!
Should we comb through it all one more time?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, Doto is the only one we still haven't found!
To think she isn't even on the rooftop, our last hope!
Then again, look at the time...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It can't be helped!
Doto-san wins the hide-and-seek tournament~!"

text_block_list.name: Dotou's Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!!
The hide-and-seek tournament came to a close through an unexpected turn of events.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorryyy... Next year, I'll definitely hide
somewhere easier to find...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, I mean... Next year...
Instead of hide-and-seek, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to... talk to the fans
with confidence, you know~...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Because there are fans out there... searching for you this earnestly... right...?

At any rate, even if a bit awkward, interacting
with her fans seemed to be great motivation.

text_block_list.name: Dotou's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found you!
Doto-san, I found youuu~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaeh!?

text_block_list.name: Dotou's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Kyaah, she's so cute in person~!

text_block_list.name: Dotou's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'm always cheering for you in your races~!
I really wanted to meet you today, Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawa, hawawawa!
P-P-People are just, flooding in?!

The crowd drew even more people, and before she
knew it, Meisho Doto was swallowed up
in a whirlwind of fans!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaah!

"When I stepped in to rescue her at the right moment,
she had completely lost all her energy."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...I'm f-fine~...
It was just, well, I g-got a bit startled, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I-I had no idea there were that many fans,
so I-I was just really surprised..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Besides...... I'm just so happy...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The power of everyone's support...
is truly amazing, isn't it? Ehehe~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
My mind and body both feel all mushy and limp...
Hawaaa~...

Though a bit clumsy, interacting with her fans
seemed to serve as wonderful inspiration for her.
